label: ESTIMATE; simulated cohorts resampled from 34 UPMC discovery patients' tissue; outcomes SYNTHETIC
source: simulated cohorts of 50-600 resampled with replacement from 34 UPMC discovery patients' tissue
interval: per point: Clopper-Pearson 95% on rejections / planted studies (200 per point on Modal)
cohort: UPMC head and neck, discovery split only

caveats.outcomes: SYNTHETIC: planted Weibull outcomes, HR 2 per source SD; no real UPMC outcome was read
caveats.source: 34 discovery patients resampled with replacement up to 600: every simulated cohort reuses the same 34 patients' tissue, so the simulation sees far less tissue variety than 600 real patients would bring; the answer is conditional on these 34
caveats.censoring: administrative censoring at one common horizon, tuned to the #83 event fraction (0.239); #83 used Charville's reverse Kaplan-Meier censoring, which needs real follow-up
caveats.plant: the atlas's plant rule (first finite feature with within-stratum variation), on UPMC's own grammar
caveats.scope: a design estimate for planning; no clinical claim

answer.statement: Simulated power first crosses 80% at about 249 patients (interpolated). The pointwise 95% CI bounds cross 80% at 201 (upper) and 289 (lower); these are pointwise intervals, not a confidence interval for n. Smallest simulated count whose pointwise lower 95% bound is at least 80%: 400.
answer.method: n_80: first crossing of 80% by the simulated power, linear in patients between the bracketing points, no extrapolation. n_80_pointwise_ci_crossings: the same crossing of the per-point 95% Clopper-Pearson upper and lower bounds; pointwise, so not a confidence interval for n_80
